selection_rule: Same feasibility Wilson-lower-bound selection as the depth-refinement release, with depth/count/ID tie breaks. Pool: source, best-fidelity product, fixed best-fidelity L2, and highest-fidelity/highest-ideal-feasibility entangling candidates within base/32/64 depth budgets. Preserve all shallower fits. Deduplicate identical logical circuits.
primary_inference: 36 jointly Holm-corrected two-sided block-conditional exact tests: six instances x two events x selected native versus full T=8/24-step source, best-fidelity product, and fixed best-fidelity shallow AQC. Two independent confirmation blocks of 32768 shots per method. Screening samples excluded. Identical-circuit controls have p=1.
secondary_inference: Ideal-to-hardware event retention and circuit resource comparisons are descriptive. Short-duration published results are not pooled with the new acquisitions.
reproduction_scope: The six previously diagnosed TSP25/VRP20 cost instances. Fit and execute the full T=8, 24-step anneal and native approximations. One screening followed by independent two-block confirmation. This is not a two-day replication study.
software: Quimb with PyTorch autodiff and bounded v2 contraction planning; exact-reference-assisted MPS target, exact final-state checks. This is not an end-to-end scalable tensor-network construction claim.
